annotations.title: Registry events of the identified sole-shareholder network

description:
Get the BORME events of every company in the identified sole-shareholder
network (as company_group returns it), newest first, within your plan's
window.

Use it before a visit ("which BORME events were published this year for
companies in X's identified sole-shareholder network") or for the
published mergers, demergers and capital changes concerning companies in
the identified network; for one company use company_history. A name is searched as in company_group.

Returns JSON {company_slug, members, member_count, group_truncated,
count, offset, next_offset, events: [{event_id, date, borme_id, province,
company_name, company_slug, member_slug, acts, registral}]}, with
plan_window on a limited plan. member_slug is the group member the event
belongs to. To page, pass next_offset as offset until it is null.

Read-only. Needs the pro plan (X-API-Key header).

act_types.description: Optional list of act type enums, e.g. ["MERGER_BY_ABSORPTION", "SEGREGATION"]. Full list: list_act_types.
act_types.title: Act Types

company.description: Company slug, e.g. vaz-metales-sl, or a name of at least 3 letters or digits; its whole group is read.
company.title: Company

date_from.description: Earliest publication date, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2025-01-01. Optional; moved up to your plan's window.
date_from.title: Date From

date_to.description: Latest publication date, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD. Optional.
date_to.title: Date To

offset.description: Events to skip, integer 0-10000 (default 0); pass the previous page's next_offset.
offset.title: Offset
